scope: Official desktop artifact and upstream skill selection only. No mobile changes, no other product implementation reads/changes, no target-app/model/skill execution.
status: source-supported normal text-link path; exact installed backend branch remains unproven
confirmed: Desktop insertSkillMentionAtSelection->tMn/Zjn creates skillMention node carrying name/path. bZ returns dollar label and href; yZ serializes as escaped Markdown link. akn+Y4 official helper controlled replay passes three cases.

Normal jdn->RTe projection produces UserInput Text with text_elements empty when no untrusted/review context; Aln appends images/comment attachments, not a skill item. Zfn sends the prepared request to turn/start or versioned admission branch. This supports the reported text-only observation, not a universal rule that Skill input is forbidden.

UserInput schema independently permits structured skill{name,path}; text_elements are UI UTF8 spans, not the skill selector identity. Both text-link and structured inputs are supported source contracts.

skills/src/selection.rs selects structured Skill paths first, blocks matching plain names even if structured target invalid, then for each Text resolves linked canonical/discovery paths before bare names. Disabled paths skipped; bare name requires exactly one enabled skill name and zero connector-slug conflicts. Linked text does not become a plain-name fallback.

ext/skills/src/selection.rs differs: structured Skill or skill-path Mention first, then each Text skill paths before plain names; enabled entry selected by main_prompt/package/display_path, bare names pick first enabled exact-name catalog entry, dedup authority+package. extension.rs370 actually calls this selector. Do not generalize the legacy ambiguity/connector guard to this route.

Host skills/list accepts cwds and forceReload. Empty cwds uses config.cwd; desktop t8r/r8r uses explicit cwd/list or workspace roots, and durable hosted branch forwards environmentId/cwd to hostedThreadFiles.listSkills. Host metadata.path is copied from path_to_skills_md, not its parent directory.

wZr generates Skills slash group dynamically from enabled/model-admitted catalog. Row id skill:path; onSelect inserts skill mention; inline slash selection uses insertMention. It is not evidence that every skill is a backend slash command.
limits: Inspected desktop package and upstream commit are independent baselines; not claimed to match the current installed app-server binary. Source main was not fetched/replaced.
Other thread runtime observation is consistent with source but was not independently recaptured here. No actual SKILL.md content loaded or executed.
Full user-history renderer, dollar versus at trigger routing and every menu origin not closed. Do not infer all entry points from the shared insertion API.
Rich label/icon query variants, escaped parentheses/Windows path conversion and other provider URI forms not covered by the three helper replays.
REA selected three small modules; app-initial/shared/primary evidence is direct scoped source inspection. REA graph unknown/alias ceilings are retained and not interpreted as absence.
No modifications, builds, deployments or API calls for other products; mobile goal remains paused.

validation.scope: three pure official mention-format cases only; no bundle bootstrap, RPC, network or skill instruction execution
